shared_findings: A separate proposal-only adaptive recurrence policy removed the two frozen raw-W4 early-route false halts on the same real Ubuntu runner while preserving accuracy; cost and recurrence count increased versus raw W4, so the result is a Pareto tradeoff rather than a scalar winner.

The same separated policy remained below fixed-budget synthetic cost and recurrence count and had substantially lower frozen regret, but all H1 task trajectories are synthetic and real-model generalization remains open.

Disposable SQLite WAL execution on the Ubuntu runner reproduced reader/checkpoint retention, single-writer SQLITE_BUSY behavior and a large host-local FULL/NORMAL commit-latency difference while preserving integrity.

The current self-hosted VPS has 4 vCPUs, about 16 GiB RAM, no swap, no visible GPU device and no installed llama.cpp/Ollama/vLLM/SGLang/Torch/Transformers runtime; therefore no real 4B model was executed in this cycle.
A concurrent Harness truth-gate PR was reviewed but not merged by this worker; review requested SHA-pinned checkout, main-lane regression inclusion and real Ubuntu receipt before acceptance.
anti_conflations: real Ubuntu execution != real model execution
synthetic frozen workload != production task distribution
SQLite NORMAL integrity != strongest power-loss durability
single-file WAL behavior != multi-file crash atomicity

routes.feedback: Retain the separated recurrence policy as a falsification candidate, not selected production policy. Keep release false until real pinned local-4B and Andreas-PC acceptance exist. Use the VPS as integration lane, not as claimed model-performance host.

Add historical/runtime episode replay and route-cost accounting for H1. Carry the SQLite held-reader/one-writer/checkpoint cases into recovery and truth-gate scenarios. Keep PR #25 draft until its own Ubuntu evidence is durable and main-lane collected.
Expose WAL/checkpoint progress, reader age and busy/retry telemetry where SQLite WAL is used. Do not choose NORMAL vs FULL from latency alone; bind durability mode to authority/recovery requirements.
Derived graph readers can affect WAL checkpoint progress; preserve materialization lineage and reader/checkpoint observability in graph recovery tests.
Represent diagnostic receipt, policy receipt and effect receipt as distinct typed/provenance-bearing objects; a policy override must not rewrite the diagnostic evidence that triggered it.

Use recurrence policy measurements as compute/outcome evidence only. Separate trajectory/readout formation from stopping policy and preserve truthful/shuffled/no-reentry controls before causal claims.
The frozen H1 improvement is not an emergence or consciousness result. Preserve the raw-W4 false halts as counterevidence and require real-task lesion/rescue/reentry receipts.
Keep raw W4, separated W4, fixed budget and other warmup policies as a set-valued operating region until held-out/runtime/real-model evidence dominates alternatives.

Highest-information next experiment remains pinned real Qwen-class 4B fixed-vs-adaptive matched trials on a capable Ubuntu host, plus representative FRANK SQLite state traffic and crash/recovery falsification.
